name: Gradle
description: Write registry credentials as Gradle properties, into gradle.properties or the environment

mode.label: Where credentials are stored
mode.help: file: the properties are written into gradle.properties (mode 0600). env: they are exported as ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_* variables from a shell environment file (mode 0600).

propertyPrefix.label: Property prefix
propertyPrefix.help: Put in front of every property name, e.g. corp gives corpTeamRegistryUsername. Empty: the names start with the repository name, as Gradle's credentials(PasswordCredentials) expects.

propertiesPath.label: Gradle properties file
propertiesPath.help: gradle.properties in the Gradle user home.

envFile.label: Shell environment file
envFile.help: Exports the ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_* variables in mode env.

name.label: Name in the properties
name.help: Repository name in Gradle, the start of the property names. Default: the instance name in lowerCamelCase.
